news.paragraph: The iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) has seen mixed commentary regarding its recent performance and outlook. While some analysts suggest small caps are benefiting from AI spending and have rallied, others caution that the current lead might be the most dangerous trade, flagging potential earnings and debt issues within the sector. The ETF's pivot points and recent run-up are under scrutiny, creating an uncertain sentiment.
